_note: Shared media library for carousels and the future reels editor. Photos live in OneDrive (keep the folder set to 'Always keep on this device'); video lives on the external drive and is only needed when a post uses it.
_reelNote: Reel covers export to reelExportsDir/<reel-id>/. reel.json clip paths are relative to reelFootageDir (e.g. broll/desk-smile-01.mp4). Carousel frames grabbed from reels go to photosDir/frames/<reel-id>/.
_videoDirNote: Set to the external drive's footage folder (e.g. E:/Scrolly Media/video) once the drive is set up.
